title: Plasma Collection Procedure \(Small Scale) for the analysis of extracellular RNA
protocol: Process sample and place into freezer within 2 hours of collection.
Collect 10 ml whole blood by peripheral venipuncture using a 21 gauge butterfly needle into a K2EDTA vacutainer tube.
Centrifuge tubes at 500 xg for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer plasma to a fresh 15 ml centrifuge tube, avoiding the buffy coat layer.
Centrifuge tubes again at 2000 xg for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Using a fresh pipet, transfer the top 80% of the plasma, avoiding the pellet at the bottom of the tube, to a fresh 15 ml tube.
Transfer 1 ml of plasma into each screw-cap microcentrifuge tube.
Place the 1 ml aliquots into a -80°C freezer for storage.
